messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager fired PD-98321 for latency SLO burn on /v1/generate. p99 > 2.5s for the last 3m in us-west-2. Affected service: inference-runtime. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/PD-98321
PagerDuty: Pager assigned to Sanjay (primary oncall). Escalation in 3m if unacked.
Sanjay: acked. I'll take this — starting triage. Can someone pull top traces and model routing heatmap?
Emily: looking. p95=1.2s, p99=2.7s sustained for 4m. Error rate unchanged. Traffic hasn't increased, but KV cache hit rate dropped ~30% on the hot weekday shard.
TJ: runbook excerpt: 1) check kvcache nodes 2) check autoscaler 3) consider diverting to compact model fallback. Quick commands:```sh
# scale inference pool
redwoodctl infra scale --pool inference-usw2 --replicas 2
# temporarily route non-enterprise to compact variant
redwoodctl route update --path /v1/generate --model-model-family=compact --duration=10m
```
Sanjay: trying kvcache warmup script now. Emily - any sign of GPU preemption or node OOMs?
Emily: no preemptions, GPU mem stable. We see increased cold starts on sidecars serving certain shards. kvcache eviction rate spiked.
IncidentBot: Pager escalated to team lead after 3m (escalation rule: no mitigation started).
Sanjay: ok pushing a short mitigation: reducing batch size to 1 for the hot route and enabling KV prefetch. Applying config now:```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","batch_size":1,"kv_prefetch":true}
```
TJ: please also flip model fallback for low-priority traffic to reduce tail cost. I'll prepare the routing change.
OncallBackup: I'll stand by to take over if this continues. ETA 10m if you need a hand.
Emily: after batch_size change p99 dropped to 1.9s in the first 90s, p95 unchanged. KV hit rate recovering slowly after warmup.
Sanjay: good. Can we keep the fallback route for another 15m and monitor? If p99 stays <2s we'll gradually revert batching.
PagerDuty: Note: Pager PD-98321 acknowledged by Sanjay at 1881234575. Escalation timer paused.
TJ: added a short circuit to routing policy to fall back to compact for non-SLAd customers. Command:```sh
redwoodctl policy apply --name quick-fallback --match "customer_tier!=enterprise" --target compact --ttl 15m
```
Emily: running evals on a small sample — quality looks fine for fallback. No customer tickets in the last 10m.
Sanjay: logging mitigation steps in incident doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-98321. Handing off active monitoring to OncallBackup for 25m while I triage deeper KV eviction root cause.
OncallBackup: ack. I'll post updates every 5m. If p99 creeps back above 2.5s, page me directly.
IncidentBot: Pager PD-98321 marked as partially mitigated. Follow-up: run KV eviction profiling and autoscaler tuning.
Sanjay: thanks team. Postmortem draft will include timeline and suggested autoscaler tweak. I'll update channel when I have root cause notes. :thumbsup:
OncallBackup: thanks — monitoring looks stable at 1881234860, p99 ~1.8s. Closing active pager window, leaving followup tasks assigned.
